title: Home-Mandate relay operator metadata v0
description: Parameters of a relay operator, published at https://<operator-domain>/.well-known/home-mandate-relay (RELAY-v0 Section 3). Draft, not part of v0.1.0 of the Home-Mandate Specification. Rules that a schema cannot express (operator_domain equals the host the document was fetched from, name_domain differs from operator_domain, enrollment is on the operator domain or below, no pin in both pin lists, at most eight pins together) are in RELAY-v0 Section 3.

relay_addresses.description: Addresses where agents reach the relay on port 443 (RELAY-v0 Sections 3, 6.4).

relay_addresses_planned.description: Addresses that replace relay_addresses from a time at least 30 days after they first appear (RELAY-v0 Section 6.4).

relay_pins.description: SHA-256 digests of the SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the keys the relay uses, base64url without padding; pinned as active pins at pairing (RELAY-v0 Section 6.8).

relay_backup_pins.description: The same for the operator's offline backup keys; pinned as backup pins. No pin may appear in both lists, and together there are at most eight (RELAY-v0 Section 6.8).

max_offline_days.description: Days an installation can be without a valid tunnel certificate before only a new pairing helps (RELAY-v0 Section 5.5). RECOMMENDED: 30.

protection_levels.description: Both levels are mandatory for every operator (RELAY-v0 Section 7).

domain.description: Lower-case DNS name with at least two labels, without a trailing dot or a port. For trust_domain this is stricter than SPIFFE, which also allows single labels and underscores.

https_url.description: HTTPS URL with a lower-case DNS host, an optional port, a path of unreserved characters and no user info, query, fragment or percent-encoding.

ip_address.description: An IPv4 address in dotted decimal, or an IPv6 address in lower case. The pattern only checks the characters; gateways parse addresses with an IP parser.
